Sub:-Timely and Quality entry of data in Legal Dash Board- reg.

Sir,

Please refer to the above mentioned subject. Development of
Legal Dash Board software is under process. It has been desired by the
Central Provident Fund Commissioner that soft copies of writ petitions and
counter replies filed in the Supreme Court, EPF Appellate Tribunal and
National Consumer cases are uploaded in Legal Dashboard. Detailed
instructions in this regard will be issued by IS Division.

2. Further, your attention is invited to Head Office Circulars of even
No. LC-9(13)2013/ACC Pending Ref. /16074, both dated 13-07-2015,
wherein detailed instructions on the above subject were issued. It is
expected that the data entry of the fresh court cases is being made in the
Legal Dashboard as per above instructions.

ch It is requested to ensure timely and quality entry of data in Legal
Dash Board and fix responsibility of Officer-in-Charge/Nodal Officer for
the lapses, if any, found at your end.

Yours’ faithfully
